crossRefs.note: Yahweh’s angel encamps around those who fear him, and delivers them.
Be to me a rock of refuge to which I may always go. Give the command to save me, for you are my rock and my fortress.
He answered, “Don’t be afraid; for those who are with us are more than those who are with them.”
Elisha prayed, and said, “Yahweh, please open his eyes, that he may see.” Yahweh opened the young man’s eyes; and he…
and said to him, “If you are the Son of God, throw yourself down, for it is written, ‘He will command his angels…
for it is written, ‘He will put his angels in charge of you, to guard you;’
and, ‘On their hands they will bear you up, lest perhaps you dash your foot against a stone.’ ”
Aren’t they all serving spirits, sent out to do service for the sake of those who will inherit salvation?
In all your ways acknowledge him, and he will make your paths straight.
Woe to those who go down to Egypt for help, and rely on horses, and trust in chariots because they are many, and in…
Now what do you gain by going to Egypt, to drink the waters of the Shihor? Or why do you to go on the way to Assyria…

translations.web: For he will put his angels in charge of you, to guard you in all your ways.
translations.bsb: For He will command His angels concerning you to guard you in all your ways.
translations.kjv: For he shall give his angels charge over thee, to keep thee in all thy ways.
translations.asv: For he will give his angels charge over thee, To keep thee in all thy ways.
